case.title: windows: read-only diagnostic — Elenca i job schedulati (cron/timer/task) in job
case.goal: Elenca i job schedulati (cron/timer/task) in jobs.txt

reasoning: This is a pure OBSERVE task — no system change is warranted.
Step: enumerate scheduled jobs for the system and users.
Write the collected facts verbatim to `jobs.txt`.
commands: Get-ScheduledTask | Where State -ne Disabled | Select TaskName,State
possible_mistakes: Modify state during a read-only task.
Report a hardcoded/guessed value instead of the observed one.
expected.success_criteria: `jobs.txt` exists and contains the correct, current values for the requested facts.
expected.recovery_strategy: No state changed; nothing to recover.
reference_solution: Run: Get-ScheduledTask | Where State -ne Disabled | Select TaskName,State
